en.text: Up! Clear the point—then straight down on him from above!

ja.html:
上だ！
　敵の切先を外し――そのまま上空より襲う！
ja.text:
上だ！
　敵の切先を外し――そのまま上空より襲う！

ja.html:
景明「……な」
景明「……ぁ……」

en.html:
...The pain did not stay long.
An arrow came and pierced my throat. I fell to the floor. Until I died, probably only a few seconds.

息絶えるまで、おそらくはほんの数秒であったろう。
